page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number top left. Running head top centre. Left margin: one note, "Hebr. 12.", beside the line "tione, dicentis". Right margin: no printed text, only ink marks.

main_text.p: nedicit Deus iis quos interna benedictione in-struxerit. Omnia igitur bona dat Deus, & omnia quærimus data; quia nec illa ipsa quæ data sunt, nec nos ipsos (adeò cæci sumus infirmitate nostra) inuenturi simus, nisi nos quotidiè exploremus, & bona Dei, tum quæ iâ ex facto dedit, tum quæ porrò gratiosè daturus est, quæramus in Domino. Horum in numero est pax, bonum suauissimum, quod se procuraturum spondebat Psalmes certa Spiritus Dei testificatione, dicentis, Persequimini pacem & sanctimoniam, sine qua nemo Deum visurus est.

Quasob res; quotquot sumus qui nomen Deo patri per Christum dedimus in spiritu, qui ad Ecclesiam indulgentissimis promissioni-bus & gratiosissimo fœdere ipsius provocamur, qui in Christo redempti sumus pretio amplis-simo, qui in Ecclesia pedes nostros consisten-tes agnoscimus virtute Dei, qui testimonio communi gratiæ diuinæ fruimur in domo eius, vt nomen ipsius pro tanta beneficentia percepta celebremus, qui ordine ipsius diuino atque humano ad ius colendum & persequendum deducimur, qui circumsplendente luce testium Dei & Christi sanctissimorum clarissimorumque ad pacem Ecclesiæ procurandam accersimur; qui denique exemplo sanctissimi Prophetæ Dauidis informamur de omnibus illis pietatis charitatisque erga Ecclesiam, & fratres, & amicos omnes officiis: fugiamus, per Deum immorta-

page.notes: Left margin note "Hebr. 12." placed before "tione, dicentis" (Heb. 12:14 reference). Right margin contains an ink blot near "amplis-simo" and small dash marks in the left margin; these are not printed text and are omitted. The running head is read as EIRENICVM with doubt, since the small capitals are heavily stylised. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed quotation "Psaltes" was read as "Psalmes" with doubt; I could not verify it letter by letter, so the word is marked here: Psaltes/Psalmes unclear. The Greek letters: none on this page.
